usage: The word '公公' refers specifically to the paternal grandfather in Cantonese.
It is a noun and typically used as a familial term when talking about family members.
You can use '公公' when introducing or talking about your grandfather on your father's side.
It is commonly used in everyday conversation among family members.
When addressing or referring to your grandfather, '公公' is respectful and affectionate.
